goal: Improve the original horse-strength WIN/TOP3 learners; do not disguise this as only changing probability postprocessing.
audit_scope: WIN/TOP3 target counts including dead heats

incumbent.training: existing reconstructed <=2024 model for 2025; existing <=2025 model for 2026

recent52.training: most recent five complete years, flat tracks10..29 only, complete unique fields, exactly one winner and three top3 labels

relative78.derived_features: within-race percentile and centered difference for twelve prior rate columns and previous finish position; no new data source

relative78_detail.parameters: 600 trees,31 leaves,max_depth8,min_child_samples80; remaining original settings unchanged

within_2025_validation: Use same four strictly forward folds as previous study, validation74 complete graded races; refit each base probability calibrator and the same 2-coefficient shared AI+market correction only on earlier training labels.
cohort_comparison: For CV compare all four families on the same complete-flat calibration rows and same119 graded race identities.
candidate_selection: Among the three new families, choose lowest pooled 2025 validation ordered-top3 logloss; ties within1e-6 choose fewer trees/features. Also report incumbent. This always freezes one research candidate for evaluation; selection is not deployment approval.
adoption_gates: candidate improves 2025 CV joint logloss vs incumbent
both unassisted WIN/TOP3 probability Brier metrics improve or do not worsen in validation
2026 same-input paired comparison improves joint logloss and both horse probability Brier
no result-based retuning, no hidden data/coverage substitution
future live feature-generation compatibility must be tested separately
evaluation: Freeze candidate family and all coefficients before its 2026 predictions. Compare on same2026 inputs against newly inferred saved incumbent, and retain prior archived baseline as a distinct comparison. Report archive96-only sensitivity and all reconstructed inputs separately.
warning: 2026 results were previously examined. This is a retrospective temporal test; no independent prospective proof or profit guarantee.
2026_inputs: Recreate actual model feature rows for all103 races. Existing probability-only checkpoints are not sufficient for new models. Prefer complete private archived features; use audited public reconstruction only when needed, with strict pre-target history.
postprocessing: Same two-coefficient geometric WIN/TOP3 plus market correction and unchanged balanced_A_v3 allocation. Fit correction separately for each base learner using2025 only.
data_preservation: Original model ZIP, history, prior predictions/results, and automation prompts unchanged. New learned binaries must remain private. Only source and small derived reports may be public.
